audit.whatIsWrong: diff read 'HARD' while diffRating was 4/10, tone was green and breakdown.difficulty/report[14] both said 'Favoured matchup'. Level chart also disagreed with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: 66.67% win rate and a green tone with 4/10 difficulty are a favoured lane; the mirror (sejuani__neeko) has win[3]=Skill, win[4]=Sejuani, win[6]=Sejuani, and the two directions must not contradict.
audit.corrected: diff EASY; rows 3, 4 and 6 flipped in both layers to Skill / Sejuani / Sejuani with matching ratings and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was sold as a clean Neeko spike; nothing mentioned that Glacial Prison out-ranges Pop Blossom or that CC cancels the setup.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 1300 range, stuns the first champion hit and reveals stealth; Pop Blossom is a 600-range leap with a preparation that is only hidden while disguised, and Inherent Glamour breaks on any immobilizing CC.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now states her 1300-range stun beats the 600-range leap, and the spike notes the disguise break.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly called Sejuani dashless ('she has no dash', 'a slow, dashless Sejuani', 'a tank who can't dash out') and credited Neeko's W with invisibility.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is a 650-range charge that knocks up and stops on the first champion hit, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. Neeko's Shapesplitter is described as a directional clone plus a third-attack proc — no invisibility. Permafrost only stuns at maximum Frost stacks, applied by Winter's Wrath.
audit.corrected: Arctic Assault named as her charge knockup with its cooldown; Frost-stack gating on Permafrost stated; the invisibility claim replaced with the disguise-break rule.

audit.why: Mirror already recorded that Inherent Glamour breaks on immobilizing CC — restated here from Neeko's side.

edits.before: Trade Q on his CS timings and hold E for the step-up. The disguise resets every bad position you take.
edits.after: Trade Q on her CS timings and hold E for the charge; one Permafrost stun strips your disguise and the trade.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — your all-in is a setup puzzle: E root, walk in as a clone or minion, R the panic.
edits.after: Both ult at 6, but hers is a 1300-range stun that reveals and locks you before your 600-range leap lands.

edits.before: You're the teamfight flank now: disguise, walk into the clump, and R three people. Lane leads become fight wins.
edits.after: She front-lines and her R chains into Permafrost; one immobilize on you breaks disguise and ends the flank.

edits.before: You farm with Q waveclear and poke her down; her only counterplay is walking into a root and eating more poke.
edits.after: You poke with Q, but Winter's Wrath stacks Frost and the 1.5s Permafrost stun breaks disguise and flips the trade.

edits.before: Pop Blossom off a landed E is a full burst combo, and you can channel it unseen from W invisibility on a tank with no escape.
edits.after: Glacial Prison stuns from 1300 range and reveals stealth; any immobilize breaks your disguise and cancels the Pop Blossom setup.

edits.before: With Q + E online you land Tangle-Barbs on a slow, dashless Sejuani and free-poke her with Blooming Burst re-blooms.
edits.after: With Q + E online you land Tangle-Barbs between her 18s Arctic Assault charges and free-poke with Blooming Burst re-blooms.

edits.before: Pop Blossom after a landed E is a full burst combo that chunks or kills a tank who can't dash out of the channel.
edits.after: Pop Blossom after a landed E chunks her, but start the wind-up before Permafrost lands — her stun breaks your disguise cover.

edits.before: Sejuani has no dash, so your Tangle-Barbs (E) lands on her almost for free — that root is the key to the whole lane. Level 1 is a wash since you only have single-target Q value and she just shoves with her cleave, so concede it and last-hit. Once you have Q + E at level 3, root her and stack Blooming Burst re-blooms on her standing body; her Permafrost passive needs repeated CC on you to bite, and she can't out-poke a re-blooming Q from range.
edits.after: Arctic Assault is a 650-range charge knockup, 18s at rank 1 — that gap, not a dashless Sejuani, is when Tangle-Barbs (E) lands for free. Level 1 is a wash: you have single-target Q and she shoves with her cleave, so concede it and last-hit. From 3, root her on the Q downtime and stack Blooming Burst re-blooms; her Frost stacks come from Winter's Wrath, and Permafrost only stuns once you are fully stacked.

edits.before: This is your lane. Her only answer to your poke is to walk into you and chain Permafrost slows into her E stun, so kite back, throw E to root her mid-approach, and punish with Q. At 6 a landed Tangle-Barbs into Pop Blossom is a real burst combo — you can ult while invisible from W to channel it unseen and stun her out of an engage. Watch her gauge: if she's full-stacked Permafrost, don't get rooted into her all-in, but otherwise you out-trade her every time she steps up.
edits.after: This is your farm lane. Her answer to poke is Arctic Assault in, Winter's Wrath for Frost stacks, then Permafrost — so kite back, root her mid-charge, and punish with Q. At 6 a landed Tangle-Barbs into Pop Blossom is a real burst combo, and the wind-up is hidden only while the disguise holds: her stun breaks it and cancels the setup, so lead with E. If she is fully Frost-stacked, do not step forward — otherwise you out-trade her every time she steps up.

edits.before: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) on her — she has no dash and the root sets up your whole Q-poke chain
edits.after: Land E (Tangle-Barbs) in her Arctic Assault downtime — the root sets up your whole Q-poke chain
